The frontend module is `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`.

The generated service client is `memoServiceClient` from `web/src/connect.ts`.

useMemoShareQueries handles memo shares, not memo CRUD.

The memo CRUD mutations and queries reside in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`, which uses the `memoServiceClient` generated service client.

q17.
`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

That module defines the memo CRUD React Query hooks (`useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, plus related comment/link queries) and imports `memoServiceClient` from `@/connect` (`web/src/connect.ts`), where it is created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)`.
